verdict_reason: Core additive readings of peninim, the three good-merchandise loci, and the non-contradictory lunar portrait of Proverbs 3 and 31 pass Rule 3 and integrate with frozen prior chapters without displacing the housewife/wisdom base. Reciprocal consilience is incremental and noncircular once the sun-moon-stars and Lucifer packets are frozen. Limited gaps remain on the Psalm 81:3 calendar identification of keseh with the month-head and on a few lexical second-senses that need tighter attestation before they can drive the gate-entry synthesis.

rule_audit.reason: Masoretic pointing is treated as one historical witness; kethib/qere and unpointed alternatives (night, double garments, shine/praise) are admitted without giving the points a presumption or extra burden.
Lexica, versions, and Strong’s supply senses and data; tradition, majority, or institutional status is not used as proof of originality or victory.

Core lexical and morphological claims for peninim, sachar, kaph, keseh/kisse identity, and halal pass the symmetrical gate; a few second-senses (orek as appropriateness, pelekh as sky circuit, yare + sheleg as worried by whiteness) are possible but less tightly attested in the packet and remain partial.

Background sun-moon-stars and Lucifer material is frozen independently; target poems and parable supply incremental portrait facts; dependencies are mapped and reversal conditions (affirmative exclusion of lunar senses or gate-pearl linkage) are stated.

Received housewife/wisdom readings and additive lunar-witness readings are treated as compatible; both remain admissible, and intent is reported separately rather than forced into an exclusive contest.

claim_ledger.claim: Hebrew peninim, often rendered rubies, is independently admissible as pearl (round), so Proverbs 3:15; 8:11; 31:10 and Job 28:18 price wisdom and the bride above pearls and supply the parable’s key word.
claim_ledger.reason: Same consonants admit a regularly cited round-pearl sense; Strong’s data and the merchant-good merchandise cluster make the pearl hearing active in the parable linkage without abolishing other gem senses.

claim_ledger.claim: Scripture stamps merchandise good in exactly three places that form one thread: Proverbs 3:14 (wisdom), Proverbs 31:18 (virtuous woman, letter-for-letter the same clause), and Matthew 13:45 (merchant seeking goodly pearls).
claim_ledger.received_or_base_reading: Separate commercial or moral statements about gain
claim_ledger.proposed_additive_reading: One intentional good-merchandise thread joining wisdom, bride, and pearl
claim_ledger.reason: Identical Hebrew clause at 3:14/31:18 plus the parable’s merchant-good vocabulary supplies positive textual linkage; exclusivity of three is chapter-asserted and not outcome-critical if near-parallels exist.
claim_ledger.outcome_changing_evidence: A counter-list of other ki-tov sachar clauses that break the three-place claim would narrow but not erase the documented 3:14–31:18 quotation.

claim_ledger.claim: Proverbs find-verbs interchange wisdom and wife (3:13; 8:35; 18:22), so the parable’s one pearl prices both without abolishing either referent.
claim_ledger.received_or_base_reading: Distinct finds of wisdom and of a wife
claim_ledger.proposed_additive_reading: Shared grammatical slot uniting wisdom and bride under the pearl price
claim_ledger.reason: Repeated find-verb pattern is text-internal and supports dual reference without contradiction.

claim_ledger.claim: Bare-letter renderings of Proverbs 3:13-20 and 31:10-31 remain morphologically and lexically admissible while painting a full-moon faithful-witness portrait (rises while night, lamp not out, palms/circuit, appointed portion, husband known in gates among elders, shine verbs).
claim_ledger.received_or_base_reading: Wisdom personified and virtuous housewife (plain sense)
claim_ledger.proposed_additive_reading: Same letters also portray the full moon as faithful witness / bride-light
claim_ledger.reason: Chapter explicitly preserves the housewife; additive senses (kaph, choq, night lamp, gates, halal shine) are attested options and cohere with frozen moon-office background, but active lunar intent for every weighed word is not affirmatively proven.
claim_ledger.affirmative_exclusion_evidence: NONE that excludes the dual hearing; poem never names moon, which underdetermines exclusive intent.
claim_ledger.outcome_changing_evidence: Tighter verse-by-verse attestation that orek, pelekh, and yare+sheleg second-senses are productive in this genre would raise intent support; affirmative exclusion of night-rise/lamp or palm-circuit senses would reverse.

claim_ledger.claim: Song of Solomon 6:9-10 signs the portrait: the one/only woman praised by daughters is fair as the moon, clear as the sun.
claim_ledger.proposed_additive_reading: Explicit moon-signature for the Proverbs one-above-daughters woman
claim_ledger.reason: Shared one/only and praise language plus explicit moon simile supplies positive cross-text support without contradiction.

claim_ledger.claim: The one pearl of great price is the full moon: one, round, white, complete, born of waters, and each city gate is one pearl (Revelation 21:21), so the pearl is also the appointed-time gate.
claim_ledger.received_or_base_reading: Parable pearl = kingdom treasure; city gates described as pearls
claim_ledger.proposed_additive_reading: Full-moon pearl = entry at the King’s moed gate
claim_ledger.reason: Properties match the full moon and gate-pearl wording is explicit; integration with moedim is coherent via background but active parabolic intent remains inference rather than a keyed saying.
claim_ledger.outcome_changing_evidence: A keyed NT interpretation of the pearl parable that excludes calendar-gate sense, or affirmative proof that pearl-gates cannot map to full-moon moedim, would reverse.

claim_ledger.claim: keseh (full moon / fulness) shares spelling and root (kasah) with kisse (throne); Psalm 81:3 and Proverbs 7:20 admit full-moon readings, and the full moon is the light-covered throne opposite the dark counterfeit seat.
claim_ledger.received_or_base_reading: kisse = throne; keseh often ‘appointed time’ or separate full-moon lemma
claim_ledger.proposed_additive_reading: Same letters bind throne and full-moon seat covered in light
claim_ledger.reason: Identical spellings and dual Job 26:9 hearing, plus Psalm 89 sun/moon throne similes from background, admit the additive without abolishing throne sense.

claim_ledger.claim: Psalm 81:3 identifies the full moon with the new-moon feast day (month head); the east gate opens on new-moon day (Ezekiel 46:1) for the full moon’s night entry, while the dark conjunction climbs another way.
claim_ledger.received_or_base_reading: New moon and full moon as distinct calendar markers; east gate opens on new-moon day
claim_ledger.proposed_additive_reading: Full moon is the month-head feast; true witness enters east gate at night
claim_ledger.reason: Astronomical full-moon east-rise at sunset is sound; linguistic claim that 81:3 equates new moon with full moon as one day is contested and not settled by the packet’s version survey alone.
claim_ledger.affirmative_exclusion_evidence: Standard calendrical practice and many readings treat new moon and full moon as separate; chapter’s no-and argument needs more grammatical and historical control.
claim_ledger.outcome_changing_evidence: Grammatical demonstration plus independent historical witnesses that biblical month-head is full moon, or affirmative exclusion of that equation, would decide the gate-entry synthesis.

claim_ledger.claim: Matthew 7:6 pearls-before-swine warns against handing holy appointed times to the nations who trample them, matching Daniel’s change of times and the prior counterfeit-moon plan.
claim_ledger.received_or_base_reading: Do not give holy teaching/valuables to unreceptive outsiders
claim_ledger.proposed_additive_reading: Pearls = holy times/gates trampled by Gentiles
claim_ledger.reason: Trample vocabulary and times contexts are real; extension from pearl-as-moed is coherent but not required by Matthew 7:6 alone.
claim_ledger.outcome_changing_evidence: Context that locks pearls to non-calendar holy things exclusively would weaken intent support.

claim_ledger.claim: Received-plus-additive model (housewife/wisdom preserved + full-moon pearl gate) explains more coordinated facts than received-only without circularity or contradiction, contrasting the light-covered seat with the dark covered seat of the prior chapter.
claim_ledger.received_or_base_reading: Received-only moral/economic readings of Proverbs and the pearl parable
claim_ledger.proposed_additive_reading: Received-plus-lunar-gate joint model unified with frozen sun-moon and Lucifer packets
claim_ledger.reason: Incremental poem facts, pearl-gate text, and light-vs-dark seat contrast increase expectedness of the joint model; background is frozen first and not double-counted as target proof.
claim_ledger.outcome_changing_evidence: Showing every portrait link reuses only background without incremental target evidence, or affirmative exclusion of the pearl-gate link, would reverse.

reciprocal_consilience.independent_background_support: Frozen ch. 29 establishes sun/Father, moon/faithful witness and bride-office, stars/righteous, elders, gates/Mazzaroth; frozen ch. 30 establishes covered lunar seat, dark vs light covering, and times corruption without relying on Proverbs 31 or the pearl parable.
reciprocal_consilience.incremental_target_evidence: Letter-for-letter good-merchandise clause, weighed dual renderings of Proverbs 3/31, Song 6 moon signature, Revelation one-pearl gates, peninim recovery, and east-gate vs other-way contrast applied to the poems and parable.
reciprocal_consilience.dependency_or_duplication_risk: Throne/full-moon and moon-as-witness themes appear in background; risk controlled when those are frozen and only poem-specific and parable-gate increments are counted for reciprocal gain.
reciprocal_consilience.strongest_base_only_or_excluding_model: Proverbs 3/31 as wisdom and housewife only; pearl as undifferentiated kingdom treasure; gates as architectural pearls; no calendar identification required.
reciprocal_consilience.comparative_result: Received-plus-additive joint model unifies merchant vocabulary, dual portrait, pearl-gate, and light-vs-dark seats with fewer leftover precise details than received-only, while preserving base readings.
reciprocal_consilience.reversal_evidence: Affirmative linguistic exclusion of key dual senses; proof that Psalm 81:3 cannot support the month-head full-moon claim if that claim is required; or demonstration that the joint model double-counts background as if it were target evidence.

category_error_audit.possible_error: Applying vocalization admission gate to symbolic or theological claims
category_error_audit.explanation: Chapter separates bare-letter lexical options from later symbolic placement and does not treat symbols as alternate vowel points of different consonants.

category_error_audit.possible_error: Forcing compatible base and additive readings into exclusive rivalry
category_error_audit.explanation: Explicitly states both housewife and light readings run at once; pointing keeps housewife, letters keep both.

category_error_audit.possible_error: Using tradition/majority/authority as proof of reading
category_error_audit.explanation: Versions and Strong’s are used as sense data; elder witnesses are cited for double garments without status-as-proof.

category_error_audit.possible_error: Circular reciprocal support from target back into background establishment
category_error_audit.explanation: Background chapters are prior and frozen; target adds poem and parable increments.

category_error_audit.possible_error: Smuggling a different-consonant textual variant into a vocalization comparison
category_error_audit.explanation: Departures are framed as attested senses of the same letters/matres, not rewritten consonants.

claims_pass_as_written: peninim admissible as pearl and prices wisdom/bride
three good-merchandise loci form a textual thread
keseh/kisse light-covered seat identity admissible and additive
Song 6 moon signature for the one woman
received-plus-additive joint model gains explanatory scope without contradiction
claims_both_admissible_additive: peninim pearl sense beside other gem senses
Proverbs 3/31 housewife-wisdom base plus lunar-witness portrait
Matthew 7:6 general holy-things warning plus times-trampling hearing
throne sense plus full-moon seat sense
claims_additive_intent_underdetermined: every weighed second-sense in the poems is actively lunar-intended
merchant parable intentionally keys the full-moon moed gate
Psalm 81:3 equates full moon with new-moon month head as one day

material_gaps.issue: Psalm 81:3 month-head identification (full moon as the new-moon feast day) is underdetermined by the packet
material_gaps.why_material: It drives the east-gate entry claim and the pearl-as-month-gate synthesis.
material_gaps.minimal_fix_or_test: Add a short grammatical note on the asyndeton and two independent historical or intertextual witnesses for full-moon month-head practice, or narrow the claim to ‘full moon as feast sign’ without equating it to conjunction new moon.

material_gaps.issue: Some poem second-senses (orek appropriateness, pelekh sky circuit, yare+sheleg whiteness anxiety) lack tight same-genre attestation in-chapter
material_gaps.why_material: They support the densest lines of the lunar portrait; if excluded, intent support drops though base readings remain.
material_gaps.minimal_fix_or_test: Footnote one clear parallel per contested gloss or mark those lines as possible rather than load-bearing.

minimal_revisions: Narrow Psalm 81:3 to full-moon feast conspicuousness unless asyndeton + historical month-head evidence is added.
Label orek, pelekh, and yare+sheleg as possible additive senses with one parallel each, not pillars.
State explicitly that pearl-gate = moed is synthesis under Rule 4/5, not a keyed dominical interpretation.
Keep the housewife base in the summary sentences wherever the lunar portrait is asserted.
Add a one-line reversal test: affirmative exclusion of night-rise/lamp-not-out or one-pearl-gate linkage would collapse the additive integration.
no_bloat_recommendation: Do not add new expository sections; insert at most a few footnotes or narrowed clauses at Psalm 81:3, the three contested glosses, and the pearl-gate synthesis statement.
